units.source_text: 太君未及读完，已经泣不成声了。

en.t: Before the lady could finish reading, she was already sobbing too hard to speak.

units.source_text: 后来答道：“妾身老而不死，命该受苦。

en.t: Afterward she replied, "I have grown old yet still do not die; it must be my fate to suffer.

units.source_text: 如今面对松树[\[12\]](#part1330.html#m12)，尚且羞愧；

en.t: Now, even when I face the pine tree[\[12\]](#part1330.html#m12), I am still ashamed;

units.source_text: 何况九重宫阙，岂敢仰望？

en.t: how much less would I dare to look up toward the ninefold palace?

units.source_text: 屡蒙圣恩宣慰，不胜铭感。

en.t: I have repeatedly received His Majesty's gracious messages of comfort, and I am more grateful than I can say.

units.source_text: 但妾自身，不便冒昧入宫。

en.t: But as for myself, it would not be proper for me to presume to enter the palace.

units.source_text: 惟窃有所感：小皇子年齿尚幼，不知缘何如此颖悟，

en.t: Yet I have one private feeling: the young prince is still so small, and I do not know why he is so remarkably intelligent,

units.source_text: 近日时刻想念父皇，急欲入宫。

en.t: but these days he thinks constantly of his imperial father and urgently wishes to enter the palace.

units.source_text: 此实人间至情，深可嘉悯。

en.t: This is truly the deepest human feeling, and it deserves deep tenderness and pity.
Please also report this matter to His Majesty on my behalf.

units.source_text: 妾身薄命，此间乃不吉之地，不宜屈留小皇子久居也……”

en.t: My fate is a poor one, and this is an inauspicious place; the young prince should not be made to remain here for long..."
